name: CleverQADeclareRelease
description: Declare a release to CleverQA so crashes and incidents attribute to it
helpMarkDown: Pass the API token from a secret pipeline variable, e.g. `$(CLEVERQA_TOKEN)`.
author: Clementina Enterprises

inputs.name: apiToken
inputs.label: API token
inputs.helpMarkDown: CleverQA API token (`tok_...`) with the `releases:write` scope. Use a secret variable, e.g. `$(CLEVERQA_TOKEN)`; never paste the token here.

inputs.name: project
inputs.label: Project
inputs.helpMarkDown: CleverQA project slug, as it appears in the project URL.

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Release version in semver, e.g. `1.4.2`. One leading `v` is stripped, so `v1.4.2` works.

inputs.name: platform
inputs.label: Platform
inputs.helpMarkDown: Must be a platform enabled on the CleverQA project.

inputs.name: buildNumber
inputs.label: Build number
inputs.helpMarkDown: Build number, if you have one, e.g. `$(Build.BuildNumber)`.

inputs.name: apiUrl
inputs.label: CleverQA URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only change this for self-hosted CleverQA.
